rapport_notes: Friendly and accommodating, smoothly handled a last-minute date-change request at the very end.

evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: if you'll be able to move some of your boxes so that you can save more with Einstein then that will be awesome

top_strength: Clear typical-vs-personalized estimate framing (the online 3.5-hour estimate vs. her adjusted 4-5 hours for the Peloton and 6th-floor walk) gave the customer real confidence in the number.
coaching_note: Booking was announced rather than explicitly asked for — no 'would you like me to get you on the schedule?' moment, so there's no clean go/no-go read from the customer before the call ends.
